name: Chimp Phobia
summary: In a hyper-immersive VR world, you strap into the suit, boot up the system, and become a monke—no rules, just bananas, tree-jumping chaos, and primal mayhem. But something’s off this time. The game doesn’t end. The NPCs start acting... aware. And that ancient monke temple deep in the jungle? It’s calling your name. Are you just playing the game—or is the game playing you? and this game has people in it!!! and i think something is there....
